summary.description: Colourless, volatile liquids with a pleasant smell, slightly soluble in water. Used primarily in dye manufacturing and as industrial solvents and fluids.
emission_sources: Industrial use in solvents, insulating and heat exchange fluids, and degreasing agents
environmental_impact: Toxic to aquatic life with potential for bioaccumulation
Can cause irritation and damage to skin, eyes, liver, lungs, and kidneys at high exposure levels
Contributes to ground-level ozone formation as a volatile organic compound (VOC), harming human health and vegetation

top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: TCBs are used across various industrial processes and their emissions raise concerns over chemical safety and waste management, necessitating improved production and consumption practices.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: High exposure to TCBs can damage vital organs and contribute to ground-level ozone, which harms respiratory health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: TCBs are highly toxic to aquatic life and can accumulate in the food chain, threatening marine biodiversity and ecosystems.
